bridge.backUpAndRestore.amazonAlexaMigra:
Your Amazon Alexa integration needs to be reconnected after migrating to a new Bridge. Please follow the steps below:

<olist><litem>Make sure you're within hearing range of an Alexa device and that it’s ready to listen.</litem><litem>Say “Alexa, discover devices.”</litem><litem>The Hue devices should now reconnect and be controllable again via Amazon Alexa.</litem></olist>
bridge.backUpAndRestore.appleHomeMigrati:
Your Apple Home integration needs to be set up again after migrating to a new Bridge. Please follow the steps below:

<olist><litem>Open the Apple Home app.</litem><litem>Tap on the three dots and go to <emph>Home Settings</emph> > <emph>Home Hubs & Bridges</emph>.</litem><litem>Select your Bridge, scroll down, and tap <emph>Remove Bridge from Home</emph>.</litem><litem>Open the Hue app.</litem><litem>Go to <emph>Settings</emph> > <emph>Smart Home</emph>.</litem><litem>Tap <emph>Apple Home</emph> and follow the on-screen instructions to set up your devices again.</litem></olist>
bridge.backUpAndRestore.googleHomeMigrat:
Your Google Home integration needs to be reconnected after migrating to a new Bridge.  Please follow the steps below:

<olist><litem>Make sure you're within hearing range of a Google Home device and that it’s ready to listen.</litem><litem>Say “Hey Google, sync devices.”</litem><litem>Your Hue devices should now reconnect and be controllable again via Google Home.</litem></olist>
bridge.backUpAndRestore.hueDevicesMigrat:
Did one of your Hue devices fail to migrate? Don’t worry, its name and settings have been moved to your new Bridge Pro. It just needs to be reconnected to start working again. 

<olist><litem>Make sure the device is connected to power or the batteries are charged/replaced.</litem><litem>In the Hue app, go to Settings > Devices.</litem><litem>Tap the category your device belongs to.</litem><litem>Devices that didn’t migrate properly will have an orange dot and status to help you identify them.</litem><litem>Tap the device you’d like to reconnect.</litem><litem>In the Device settings, scroll down and tap “Reconnect”</litem><litem>Follow the on-screen instructions.</litem><litem>Once your device is found it will work again like it did before migration.</litem></olist>
bridge.backUpAndRestore.lutronAuroraInst:
The names and configurations of your Lutron Aurora have been moved to your new Bridge. It just needs to be reconnected.

<olist><litem>In the Hue app, go to Settings > Devices > Switches and select Lutron Aurora in the list.</litem><litem>In the Device settings, scroll down and tap "Reconnect".</litem><litem>Follow the on-screen instructions.</litem><litem>Once your Lutron Aurora is found it will work again like it did before migration.</litem></olist>
